data.name: SectionMetadata
data.value: metadata
data.comment: Section name, inserted into other messages.

data.name: SectionFileIndex
data.value: file index
data.comment: Section name, inserted into other messages.

data.name: SectionFileData
data.value: file data
data.comment: Section name, inserted into other messages.

data.name: BadIdentifier
data.value: The file doesn't start with "SNGPKG", so it isn't an .sng file.

data.name: UnsupportedVersionFormat
data.value: The file uses format version {0}. Only version 1 is supported.
data.comment: {0} is the version number read from the file.

data.name: HeaderTruncatedFormat
data.value: The file is only {0:N0} bytes long, too short for the 26-byte header.
data.comment: {0} is the file size in bytes.

data.name: SectionTruncatedFormat
data.value: The file ends before the {0} section's length field.
data.comment: {0} is a section name.

data.name: SectionPastEndFormat
data.value: The {0} section says it is {1:N0} bytes long, which runs past the end of the file.
data.comment: {0} is a section name; {1} is the declared length.

data.name: FilePastEndFormat
data.value: "{0}" is {1:N0} bytes at offset {2:N0}, which runs past the end of the file.
data.comment: {0} is a stored filename; {1} its length; {2} its offset.

data.name: SectionTooLargeFormat
data.value: The {0} section says it is {1:N0} bytes long, which is too large to be real.
data.comment: {0} is a section name; {1} is the declared length.

data.name: LengthMismatchFormat
data.value: The {0} section says it is {1:N0} bytes long, but its entries use {2:N0}.
data.comment: {0} is a section name; {1} the declared length; {2} the bytes actually used.

data.name: EntryOverrunFormat
data.value: Entry {0:N0} in the {1} section runs past the section's declared length of {2:N0} bytes.
data.comment: {0} is the 1-based entry number; {1} a section name; {2} the declared length.

data.name: NegativeKeyLengthFormat
data.value: Metadata entry {0:N0} has a negative key length ({1:N0}).
data.comment: {0} is the 1-based entry number; {1} the length.

data.name: NegativeValueLengthFormat
data.value: Metadata entry {0:N0} has a negative value length ({1:N0}).
data.comment: {0} is the 1-based entry number; {1} the length.

data.name: CountTooLargeFormat
data.value: The {0} section says it holds {1:N0} entries, which can't fit in its {2:N0} bytes.
data.comment: {0} is a section name; {1} the declared count; {2} the declared length.

data.name: InvalidKeyTextFormat
data.value: Metadata key {0:N0} isn't valid UTF-8 or contains a NUL byte.
data.comment: {0} is the 1-based entry number.

data.name: InvalidValueTextFormat
data.value: The value of metadata key "{0}" isn't valid UTF-8 or contains a NUL byte.
data.comment: {0} is the key.

data.name: InvalidFilenameTextFormat
data.value: Filename {0:N0} isn't valid UTF-8 or contains a NUL byte.
data.comment: {0} is the 1-based entry number.

data.name: FileOutsideDataFormat
data.value: "{0}" is {1:N0} bytes at offset {2:N0}, which is outside the file data section.
data.comment: {0} is a stored filename; {1} its length; {2} its offset.

data.name: FilesOverlapFormat
data.value: "{0}" and "{1}" overlap in the file data.
data.comment: {0} and {1} are stored filenames.

data.name: FileDataGaps
data.value: There are unused bytes between files in the file data.

data.name: FileDataOutOfOrder
data.value: Files aren't stored in the same order as the file index lists them.

data.name: FileDataSumMismatchFormat
data.value: The file sizes add up to {0:N0} bytes, but the file data section says it is {1:N0}.
data.comment: {0} is the sum of file sizes; {1} the declared section length.

data.name: TrailingBytesFormat
data.value: There are {0:N0} extra bytes after the end of the file data section.
data.comment: {0} is the number of extra bytes.

data.name: ReasonTooLongFormat
data.value: it is {0:N0} bytes long, and stored names can be at most {1:N0}
data.comment: {0} is the name's length in UTF-8 bytes; {1} the limit.

data.name: ReasonDotDot
data.value: it contains ".."

data.name: ReasonEmptySegment
data.value: it has an empty folder or file name

data.name: ReasonControlCharacter
data.value: it contains a control character

data.name: ReasonReservedCharacterFormat
data.value: it contains "{0}", which isn't allowed in filenames
data.comment: {0} is the offending character.

data.name: ReasonTrailingCharacter
data.value: a folder or file name ends with a period or a space

data.name: ReasonReservedNameFormat
data.value: "{0}" is a reserved name on Windows
data.comment: {0} is the reserved name, e.g. CON.

data.name: FilenameProblemFormat
data.value: "{0}" can't be stored: {1}.
data.comment: {0} is the filename; {1} one of the Reason* strings.

data.name: DuplicateFilenameFormat
data.value: "{0}" and "{1}" have the same name when case is ignored.
data.comment: {0} and {1} are the two filenames.

data.name: UnsafeExtractNameFormat
data.value: "{0}" wasn't extracted because it isn't a safe filename: {1}.
data.comment: {0} is the stored filename; {1} one of the Reason* strings.

data.name: ExtractOutsideFolderFormat
data.value: "{0}" wasn't extracted because it would be written outside the output folder.
data.comment: {0} is the stored filename.

data.name: DuplicateExtractNameFormat
data.value: "{0}" wasn't extracted because another file with the same name, ignoring case, already was.
data.comment: {0} is the stored filename.

data.name: StoredSongIni
data.value: The .sng contains its own song.ini. It wasn't extracted; the song.ini generated from the metadata was written instead.

data.name: KeyForbiddenCharacterFormat
data.value: The metadata key "{0}" contains ;, =, a line break or a NUL, which song.ini can't hold.
data.comment: {0} is the key.

data.name: ValueForbiddenCharacterFormat
data.value: The value of "{0}" contains ;, a line break or a NUL, which song.ini can't hold.
data.comment: {0} is the key.

data.name: EmptyKey
data.value: A metadata entry has an empty key.

data.name: EmptyValueDroppedFormat
data.value: "{0}" has an empty value and was left out.
data.comment: {0} is the key.

data.name: FixSnapNearest
data.value: Snap to the nearest grid line
data.comment: A way to fix an off-grid note (CHR004), as its menu lists it.

data.name: FixSnapBefore
data.value: Snap to the grid line before
data.comment: A way to fix an off-grid note (CHR004) when the nearest grid line is after it.

data.name: FixSnapAfter
data.value: Snap to the grid line after
data.comment: A way to fix an off-grid note (CHR004) when the nearest grid line is before it.

data.name: FixDeleteChord
data.value: Delete the note
data.comment: A way to fix an off-grid note or chord (CHR004).

data.name: FixMakePlain
data.value: Make it a plain note
data.comment: A way to fix a sustain shorter than the cutoff (CHR021).

data.name: FixLengthenToCutoff
data.value: Lengthen it to the sustain cutoff
data.comment: A way to fix a sustain shorter than the cutoff (CHR021).

data.name: FixRemoveOpen
data.value: Remove the open note
data.comment: A way to fix an open note in a chord (CHR022).

data.name: FixKeepOpen
data.value: Keep only the open note
data.comment: A way to fix an open note in a chord (CHR022): the frets are removed.

data.name: FixDeleteLater
data.value: Delete the later note
data.comment: A way to fix two notes too close together (CHR026).

data.name: FixDeleteEarlier
data.value: Delete the earlier note
data.comment: A way to fix two notes too close together (CHR026).

data.name: FixSwitchToPro
data.value: Switch to Pro drums
data.comment: A way to fix tom markers on 4-lane drums (CHR045).

data.name: FixRemoveTomMarkers
data.value: Remove the tom markers
data.comment: A way to fix tom markers on 4-lane drums (CHR045).

data.name: PartKeyDroppedFormat
data.value: "{0}" is for a part the chart has no notes for, and was left out.
data.comment: {0} is the key.

data.name: MetadataNotWrittenFormat
data.value: "{0}" was left out of song.ini because its key or value contains a character song.ini can't hold.
data.comment: {0} is the key.

data.name: PairKeyForbidden
data.value: The key contains ;, =, a line break or a NUL, which song.ini can't hold.

data.name: PairValueForbidden
data.value: The value contains ;, a line break or a NUL, which song.ini can't hold.

data.name: PairKeyEmpty
data.value: The key is empty.

data.name: PairValueEmpty
data.value: The value is empty, so packing leaves it out.

data.name: PairDuplicateKey
data.value: The key appears more than once; only the last value is kept.

data.name: PairExpectedInteger
data.value: Expected a whole number, e.g. 150 or -1.

data.name: PairExpectedBoolean
data.value: Expected True or False.

data.name: PairLenientBooleanFormat
data.value: Write this as {0}: some games only read True or False exactly.
data.comment: {0} is True or False.

data.name: PairExpectedColor
data.value: Expected a hex colour, e.g. #FF8800.

data.name: PairExpectedIntegerPair
data.value: Expected two whole numbers separated by a space, e.g. 55000 85000.

data.name: PairExpectedTuning
data.value: Expected 4 to 6 whole numbers, optionally followed by a quoted name, e.g. 0 0 0 0 0 0 "Standard".

data.name: PairLegacyKeyFormat
data.value: A legacy key; newer games read {0} instead.
data.comment: {0} is the key that replaced it.

data.name: QuickFixSetValueFormat
data.value: Change to {0}
data.comment: A quick fix that replaces a pair's value. {0} is the new value, e.g. True.

data.name: QuickFixRemoveKey
data.value: Remove the key
data.comment: A quick fix that removes a pair, e.g. one with an empty value.

data.name: QuickFixStripForbidden
data.value: Remove the ; and line breaks
data.comment: A quick fix that removes the characters song.ini can't hold from a value; line breaks become spaces.

data.name: QuickFixRenameKeyFormat
data.value: Rename to {0}
data.comment: A quick fix that renames a legacy key. {0} is the key that replaced it.

data.name: QuickFixMergeDuplicates
data.value: Remove the repeats
data.comment: A quick fix that keeps one line of a key stored more than once, with the value it has.

data.name: NoAudioStem
data.value: There's no audio stem (song, guitar, drums and the like), so the song plays in silence.

data.name: NoSongIni
data.value: There's no song.ini, so the .sng will have no metadata.

data.name: SongIniNoSongSection
data.value: song.ini has no [song] section, so the .sng will have no metadata.

data.name: SongIniTooLarge
data.value: song.ini is too large to read.

data.name: ExcludedJunkFormat
data.value: "{0}" was left out as OS or tool junk.
data.comment: {0} is a file or folder path.

data.name: ExcludedNestedSngFormat
data.value: "{0}" was left out because an .sng can't contain another .sng.
data.comment: {0} is a file path.

data.name: ExcludedSubfolderFormat
data.value: The subfolder "{0}" was left out because subfolders aren't included.
data.comment: {0} is a folder path.

data.name: ChrNoTimeSignatureAtStart
data.value: There's no time signature at the start; the games assume 4/4.

data.name: ChrTempoOutOfRangeFormat
data.value: A tempo of {0} BPM is outside 20 to 400, which is probably a typo or a half- or double-time mistake.
data.comment: {0} is the tempo.

data.name: ChrNotesAfterAudioFormat
data.value: Notes after the end of the audio: {0}.
data.comment: {0} is how many.

data.name: ChrPhrasesAfterAudioFormat
data.value: Phrases after the end of the audio: {0}.
data.comment: {0} is how many.

data.name: ChrEventAfterAudioFormat
data.value: The event "{0}" is after the end of the audio.
data.comment: {0} is the event's text.

data.name: ChrOffGrid
data.value: The note isn't on any common grid (1/1 to 1/192, or a triplet).

data.name: ChrDuplicateTempo
data.value: Two tempo markers are on the same tick; the games read only the last.

data.name: ChrDuplicateTimeSignature
data.value: Two time signatures are on the same tick; the games read only the last.

data.name: ChrSustainIntoNext
data.value: The sustain runs into the next note on its lane, so the games cut it short.

data.name: ChrSustainUnderCutoffFormat
data.value: The sustain is shorter than the sustain cutoff ({0} ticks), so the games read it as a plain note.
data.comment: {0} is the cutoff in ticks.

data.name: ChrOpenInChord
data.value: An open note is in a chord with frets; the games read it differently.

data.name: ChrRedundantForceHopo
data.value: The chord is forced HOPO, but it's a HOPO anyway.

data.name: ChrRedundantForceStrum
data.value: The chord is forced strum, but it's a strum anyway.

data.name: ChrForcedRepeat
data.value: A forced HOPO repeats the note or chord before it exactly, so it can't be hammered on.

data.name: ChrFirstNoteHopo
data.value: The part's first note is a HOPO; there's nothing to hammer on from.

data.name: ChrCloseNotes
data.value: Two notes on the same lane are closer than 1/64 of a whole note; the later is probably a stray duplicate.

data.name: ChrTomMarkerCoversNothing
data.value: The tom marker covers no note on its pad, so it does nothing.

data.name: ChrTooManyPads
data.value: More than two pads are hit at once, not counting the kick: more hands than a drummer has.

data.name: ChrFillInStarPower
data.value: The drum fill overlaps a star power phrase.

data.name: ChrFillEndsWithoutNoteFormat
data.value: The drum fill's last note isn't on {0}, so there's nothing to activate star power on there.
data.comment: {0} is the difficulty, e.g. Hard.

data.name: ChrRollTooFew
data.value: The roll has fewer than two notes in it.

data.name: ChrTrillTooFew
data.value: The trill has fewer than two notes in it.

data.name: ChrTrillOnePad
data.value: The trill covers only one pad; a trill goes between two.

data.name: ChrTomMarkersOnFourLane
data.value: 4-lane drums have tom markers. The games would read them as Pro drums, so saving leaves them out.

data.name: ChrFifthPadNotFiveLane
data.value: A fifth-pad note (5-lane green) on drums that aren't 5-lane.

data.name: ChrDrums2xTrack
data.value: The chart has a PART DRUMS_2X track. It's kept as it is, and doesn't follow edits to PART DRUMS.

data.name: ChrEmptyStarPower
data.value: The star power phrase has no notes in it.

data.name: ChrEmptySolo
data.value: The solo has no notes in it.

data.name: ChrStarPowerEmptyOnDifficultyFormat
data.value: The star power phrase has no notes in it on {0}, though other difficulties have some.

data.name: ChrSoloEmptyOnDifficultyFormat
data.value: The solo has no notes in it on {0}, though other difficulties have some.

data.name: ChrOverlappingStarPower
data.value: Two star power phrases overlap; saving merges them.

data.name: ChrOverlappingSolos
data.value: Two solos overlap; saving merges them.

data.name: ChrNotesInBigRockEnding
data.value: Notes are inside a big rock ending, which the games skip.

data.name: ChrEmptyPart
data.value: The part is in the chart but has no notes on any difficulty.

data.name: ChrLowerDifficultyDenserFormat
data.value: {0} has more notes per second ({1:0.0}) than {2} ({3:0.0}).
data.comment: {0} and {2} are difficulties, the lower first; {1} and {3} are their chords per second.

data.name: ChrNoSections
data.value: The chart has no sections.

data.name: ChrUnratedFormat
data.value: The part has notes but {0} is unset or -1.
data.comment: {0} is the song.ini key, e.g. diff_guitar.

data.name: ChrSongLengthFormat
data.value: song_length ({0} ms) doesn't match the audio's length ({1} ms).
data.comment: {0} is song.ini's value; {1} is the audio's length.

data.name: ChrEndMissing
data.value: There's no [end] event; saving adds one after the last note.

data.name: ChrEndEarly
data.value: [end] is before the last note; saving moves it after it.

data.name: ChrLoadUnholdableTempo
data.value: A tempo marker of 0 microseconds per beat was left out, as the games skip it.

data.name: ChrLoadUnholdableTimeSignature
data.value: A time signature of 0 beats was left out, as the games skip it.

data.name: ChrLoadStrayAnchor
data.value: An anchor that isn't on a tempo marker, or a second one on it, was left out, as it anchors nothing.

data.name: ChrLoadFirstEventDropped
data.value: The track's first event, which the games never read, wasn't its name, and was left out.

data.name: ChrLoadDuplicateNote
data.value: A second note on a lane at one tick was left out, as the games leave it out.

data.name: ChrLoadDuplicateOpen
data.value: A note made open by a Phase Shift open phrase, in a chord that already has an open note, was left out.

data.name: ChrLoadOpenBeforeEnhancedOpens
data.value: A note below green before [ENHANCED_OPENS], which the games don't read, was left out.

data.name: ChrLoadUnpairedNoteEvent
data.value: A note-on or note-off that the games pair with nothing was left out.

data.name: ChrLoadUnpairedSysexEvent
data.value: A Phase Shift open or tap event that the games pair with nothing was left out.

data.name: ChrLoadUnusedMarker
data.value: A force HOPO, force strum, tap or open marker that covers no note was left out.

data.name: ChrLoadUnreadStarPower
data.value: A star power phrase on pitch 116 was left out, as multiplier_note puts star power on 103 and the games don't read it.

data.name: ChrLoadDuplicateStarPower
data.value: A second star power phrase starting at one tick was left out, as the games leave it out.

data.name: ChrVocalNotesOverlap
data.value: The vocal note runs into the next one; a part sings one note at a time.

data.name: ChrVocalNoteWithoutLyric
data.value: The vocal note has no lyric.

data.name: ChrVocalNoteOutsidePhrase
data.value: The vocal note is outside every phrase, so the games don't show it.

data.name: ChrLyricWithoutNote
data.value: The lyric isn't on a vocal note's start.

data.name: ChrSlideWithoutNote
data.value: The slide has no sung note before it in its phrase to carry on from.

data.name: ChrHarmonyWithoutFirst
data.value: The chart has this harmony without HARM1, which the games need to show harmonies.

data.name: ChrLoadWithPitchFormat
data.value: {0} (MIDI note {1})
data.comment: {0} is what was left out; {1} is its MIDI note number.
